comparison.method: standalone CUDA harness compiled directly against the pinned upstream codebook header and a literal copy of the pinned pack kernel body
comparison.result: Gem16 CPU oracle is byte-identical for K3/K4 packing and bit-identical for all three procedural codebooks on the bounded golden vectors.

limitations: This validates format primitives only, not Viterbi encoding, LDLQ, transforms, or a quantized model layer.
The bounded CUDA comparison is diagnostic evidence and not a runtime performance claim.
